{{Quote|I met with him just last year, when I invited the Junction system to join the Confederacy. Nod declined. He's dead now.|Dooku|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Junction system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Vorc sector/Legends|Vorc sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Junction V]] and the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Delaluna]].
